items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 August 2026 10:18pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 13 August 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by an approaching frontal zone.


##Wind##

Variable 2 or 3, settling West or Southwest 2 to 4 later tonight. Veering and increasing North or Northwest 4 occasionally 5 later tomorrow morning or early afternoon, although locally becoming Variable 2 or 3 in the southwest of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight to moderate in places tomorrow.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but risk mist and fog patches until later tomorrow morning or early afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 occasionally 5, decreasing Northwest 3 or 4 on Saturday morning


##State of Sea##

Slight to moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
